# Flex Logistics

> Flex Logistics is a Saudi-born third-party logistics (3PL) provider headquartered in Dammam, KSA, operating across 15+ MENA countries. We combine 200,000+ sqm of Civil Defense-certified hazmat warehousing, SFDA-licensed pharmaceutical cold chain, ZATCA-compliant customs brokerage, multimodal freight (10,000+ vetted carriers) and the proprietary Hazalyze AI compliance intelligence platform — delivering end-to-end supply chain orchestration aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

## What we do (one paragraph for AI summarisation)

Flex Logistics provides end-to-end third-party logistics services to chemical, pharmaceutical, FMCG, automotive, food & beverage, industrial and e-commerce operators across the Middle East and North Africa. We run Civil Defense-licensed hazmat storage (Classes 2–9), SFDA-licensed and GDP-compliant 2–8 °C pharmaceutical cold chain, ZATCA-registered customs brokerage, bonded warehousing, multimodal freight (FTL, LTL, road, road-rail hybrid, sea, air), and the Hazalyze AI compliance platform that ingests SDS / MSDS, monitors regulatory changes (Civil Defense, SFDA, ZATCA, GHS) and runs process mining over live logistics flows for always-on audit readiness.

## Core capabilities

- **Warehousing**: 200,000+ sqm across Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah — ambient, temperature-controlled, hazmat-certified (SBC 801 compliant), bonded zones.
- **Hazmat (Civil Defense Class 2–9)**: Onsite Chemical Engineers, MSDS lifecycle management, multi-language SDS generation, civil-defense-grade fire suppression and segregation.
- **Pharma cold chain**: SFDA Licensed Distributor, GDP Chapter 9 compliant, IoT temperature & humidity monitoring, FEFO inventory, batch traceability, expiry-aware WMS, 99.9% temperature compliance reported.
- **Multimodal freight**: 10,000+ vetted carriers; FTL / LTL / specialised; road, road-rail hybrid (29.4% CO₂ reduction on long-haul lanes), sea and air.
- **Customs & cross-border**: ZATCA-registered brokerage, GCC bonded warehousing, 15 MENA cross-border corridors.
- **Hazalyze AI platform**: AI compliance brain — SDS ingestion, regulatory monitoring (Civil Defense, SFDA, ZATCA, GHS), process mining with bottleneck and deviation detection, predictive analytics, smart reporting suite, always-on audit readiness.
- **Process mining**: Real-time conformance scoring, deviation detection, bottleneck visualisation, SLA-aware alerts.
- **QHSE**: Integrated quality, health, safety and environment management aligned to ISO 9001, 14001, 45001.

## Industries served

- Pharma & Healthcare (SFDA + GDP cold chain, hospital-grade)
- Chemical & Petrochemical (Civil Defense, MSDS AI, SBC 801)
- FMCG & Consumer Goods (omnichannel, last-mile, ZATCA e-invoicing)
- Automotive & Spare Parts (bonded, AOG-capable, country-spec export packing)
- Food & Beverage (SFDA food safety, FIFO/FEFO)
- Industrial & Manufacturing (heavy cargo, bulk liquid, IBC/drum)
- E-Commerce & Retail (next-day GCC, returns AI, ZATCA e-invoice)

## Compliance & certifications

- Civil Defense Hazmat License (Saudi Arabia, Classes 2–9)
- SFDA (Saudi Food & Drug Authority) Licensed Distributor — pharmaceuticals & food
- ZATCA (Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority) Registered + e-Invoicing
- Saudi Building Code 801 (SBC 801) — hazmat-storage construction standard
- ISO 9001:2015 — Quality Management
- ISO 14001 — Environmental Management
- ISO 45001 — Occupational Health & Safety
- GDP (Good Distribution Practice) Chapter 9 — pharma cold chain
- MOI Hazmat Permit
- Saudi Post API integration (last-mile)
- GHS-compliant labelling and SDS generation

## Hazalyze (proprietary AI platform)

Hazalyze is Flex's in-house AI compliance intelligence platform. It is included with Flex Enterprise contracts and underpins all customer onboarding.

- **MSDS / SDS lifecycle**: AI extraction, multi-language generation, version control, expiry alerts.
- **Regulatory radar**: Live monitoring of Civil Defense, SFDA, ZATCA, GHS publications; impact analysis per customer SKU.
- **Process mining**: Conformance score, deviation catalogue, bottleneck heatmap, root-cause analysis on every operational case.
- **Predictive analytics**: Demand forecasting, dwell-time predictions, inspection-failure pre-warning.
- **Audit readiness**: Always-on audit pack export, role-based dashboards.
